pair_cross_section.systematic_combination: Use the five AN percentages directly and combine them in quadrature; do not rescale them to the rounded 2.5 pb display value.
pair_cross_section.phase_space: prompt Jpsi pair; each Jpsi 10<pT<40 GeV and abs(y)<2.0; m(JJ)>7.5 GeV
pair_cross_section.visible_convention: physical pair cross section after division by B(Jpsi->mumu)^2
pair_cross_section.source: current AN total prompt-prompt fiducial cross section and its five active systematic percentages

single_jpsi_cross_section.phase_space: prompt Jpsi; 10<pT<40 GeV and abs(y)<2.0; no pair-mass requirement

branching_fraction.treatment: common B cancels exactly between X^2 and the pair-visible denominator; remove the pair BR systematic component and add no separate BR uncertainty

mass_extrapolation.method: factorized event mixing of the two GEN_pair_id slots from DPS GEN-only acceptance MC; combine different source events
mass_extrapolation.uncertainty_status: fixed central factor for this preliminary round by explicit user instruction; this does not assert zero uncertainty
mass_extrapolation.user_gate: On 2026-08-29 the user instructed that the mJJ extrapolation correction must be included and its uncertainty is not considered in the current round.
mass_extrapolation.future_uncertainty_proposal: Estimate finite-source precision with a delete-one-source-event jackknife of the epsilon_m numerator/denominator; treat generator/model variations as potentially correlated with the pure-DPS full-workflow closure.
mass_extrapolation.correlation_with_pure_dps_closure: The artifacts are different analysis levels, but both depend on the current DPS generator/model; model correlation is unknown and must not be silently combined as independent in a future uncertainty update.

correlations.statistical: Cov(f_DPS,sigma_pair_total) unavailable; report rho=0 preliminary reference and rho=-1,0,+1 sensitivity
correlations.systematic: The five AN pair sources are propagated individually. BR and luminosity have explicit treatments; acceptance/efficiency, lifetime-variable, and fitter correlations with the f_DPS workflow remain unknown and use conditional independence only for this preliminary numerical reference.
correlations.luminosity: ATLAS single-Jpsi and CMS pair luminosity sources treated as independent

cr_sps_leakage.variation: SPS MC supplies r_SPS^CR and the MC-leakage variants subtract the corresponding SPS contribution before DPS normalization
cr_sps_leakage.combination: zero/MC-leakage variants and CR boundary changes form one CR definition/purity envelope; not an additional independent source
cr_sps_leakage.downward_endpoint: abs(Delta phi)<=110 deg with MC-leakage treatment
cr_sps_leakage.future_improvement: reduce or replace SPS-MC dependence using data constraints, alternative generators/models, or a more direct leakage validation
